purpose: Repair only the somatic and BAP protocol-transcription failures exposed by S1c, without rerunning successful NMDA/calcium arms or selecting on S1c outcomes.

design.same_state_pairing: All arms in each family share equilibrium state, Random123 seed, duration and pre-intervention history.

preregistered_outcome_gates: single 3 nA has zero soma peaks >= 0 mV in each split
single 6 nA has soma peak >= 0 mV in every trajectory in each split
assist-only has zero soma peaks >= 0 mV and zero trunk peaks >= -20 mV in each split
p2-factor3 soma-only has zero trunk peaks >= -20 mV in each split
p3-factor3 soma-only has trunk peak >= -20 mV in every trajectory in each split
exploratory_not_selection_gates: historical p3-factor2 soma-only versus combined contrast
decision_rule: If integrity and all preregistered controls pass, combine S1c successful arms with S1d repaired arms to specify a fresh larger hybrid corpus. Do not train on S1d and do not call it a held-out test.
